comparisons.peer_summary: Citi eliminated the Institutional Clients Group and Personal Banking and Wealth Management layers in Q4 2023, exited certain institutional business lines, consolidated its regional structure into one international group, and centralized client capabilities and global staff functions to simplify its organization.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and Citi disclose that their 'Corporate' or 'Other Corporate' segments include centrally managed, shared staff functions that support the broader organization. JPM explicitly lists functions such as Technology, Legal, Human Resources, and Risk Management as part of Other Corporate, noting these are centrally managed. Citi similarly describes consolidating its structure by 'centralizing client capabilities and streamlining its global staff functions' as part of its simplification initiatives, indicating a comparable strategic approach to organizing central overhead and support functions within the corporate reporting unit.

sentences.text: Other Corporate includes staff functions and expense that is centrally managed as well as certain Firm initiatives and activities not solely aligned to a specific LOB.

The major Other Corporate functions include Real Estate, Technology, Legal, Corporate Finance, Human Resources, Internal Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, Control Management, Corporate Responsibility and various Other Corporate groups.

As part of its overall simplification initiatives, in the fourth quarter of 2023, Citi eliminated the previous Institutional Clients Group and Personal Banking and Wealth Management layers, exited certain institutional business lines, and consolidated its regional structure, creating one international group, while centralizing client capabilities and streamlining its global staff functions.

comparisons.peer_topic: Financial Statement Classification of Restructuring Charges
comparisons.peer_summary: Restructuring charges are recorded as a separate line item within Operating expenses in the Consolidated Statement of Income and were included within the All Other-Corporate/Other category.
comparisons.comparison: Both disclosures address the financial classification and treatment of expenses within the Corporate/Other Corporate segment. JPM defines the composition of Other Corporate, which serves as the bucket for centrally managed staff and firm initiatives. Citi explicitly states that its restructuring charges (a significant corporate-level expense) are included within the 'All Other-Corporate/Other' category. This confirms that both firms allocate non-LOB specific costs, including restructuring and central staff expenses, to this same reporting bucket.
